name: agentic-sdlc
description: End-to-end agentic SDLC for Claude Code: issue → worktree → pre-flight risk read → implement → authoritative gate → PR → risk-gated review → auto-merge, with a run record per PR. A single-context harness with hard authority boundaries. Repo-agnostic; reads each project's AGENTS.md (canonical knowledge home) for its invariants + constitution.
